character.manipulateHint: Dragging a joint turns the bone arriving at it: the limb follows as one, and its skin with it
character.editRestHint: Put a joint back where it belongs without deforming the character: the mesh stays still

character.borrowHint: The skeleton is copied and fitted to this character. It belongs to it afterwards.
character.borrowNone: No character in this project carries a skeleton.

character.socketEmpty: No attachment point. An object is hung on one from a scene.
character.motionOpenHint: The keys of this motion come back on the band, exactly as they were posed
character.motionEmpty: This character cannot play any motion yet.
character.saveFault_not-glb: This file is not a model the studio can write back.
character.saveFault_no-buffer: This file carries no geometry to skin.
character.saveFault_unknown-primitive: The geometry of this file has changed since it was opened.
character.saveFault_compressed-primitive: The geometry of this file is compressed. The studio cannot write a skeleton into it.
